ticket_key.description: Jira key of the OPSLSY change ticket to transition.

target_status.description: Destination Jira status name (matched case-insensitively, whitespace-trimmed, exact equality to transition.to.name).

fields.description: Optional Jira transition fields. Keys must be Jira field ids/names accepted by the selected transition.

Compose_Validation_Errors.inputs: @union(if(empty(outputs('Compose_Request')?['ticket_key']), array('ticket_key is required.'), json('[]')), if(empty(outputs('Compose_Request')?['target_status']), array('target_status is required.'), json('[]')))

body.error: @{concat('Ticket is out of scope. Expected project ', parameters('JiraProjectKey'), ' and issue type in [', join(parameters('AllowedIssueTypes'), ', '), '], got project ', trim(string(coalesce(body('Parse_Ticket')?['fields']?['project']?['key'], 'unknown'))), ' and issue type ', trim(string(coalesce(body('Parse_Ticket')?['fields']?['issuetype']?['name'], 'unknown'))), '.')}

runError.message: Ticket is outside configured project/type scope.

body.error: @{concat('Expected exactly one direct transition to status ', outputs('Compose_Request')?['target_status'], ', found ', string(length(body('Filter_Matching_Transitions'))), '.')}
